title: Pathfinder with Portals
objectives: Implement Dijkstra's algorithm for shortest path finding
Handle weighted terrain with different movement costs
requirements: Find shortest path from start to goal in a 2D grid
Support weighted terrain (digits 1-9 represent movement cost)
Implement portal teleportation (letters A-Z represent bidirectional portals)
Return path as array of [row, col] coordinates
stretchGoals: Support multiple goals and return paths to all
Add visualization of the pathfinding process
Handle dynamic obstacles that change during pathfinding
constraints: Must handle edge cases (no path, start == goal)
Time complexity should be reasonable for given constraints
